meta.name: competitive-intel-watch
meta.description: Scheduled delta monitoring against a prior competitive snapshot. Use when tracking competitors on a cadence: material shifts only, cited evidence, battle-card update flags, runs unattended.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定时追踪竞品动态，只推送实质性变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期跟踪竞品并自动生成战报
copy.tagline_en: Track competitors on a schedule, get only material changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor competitors regularly and auto-generate battle cards

howto.what: 提供上一轮竞品快照后,扫描对手网站、定价页、新闻等,只报告会让人行动的实质变化(如定价改动、发布/停售、定位转变、人事变动、融资并购、大客户得失),每条附 URL 和日期,并指出 battle card 或定位章节需要更新;本轮没有就直说。无快照时先建基线。
howto.when: 当你说要按每周/每月等节奏跟踪竞品,并给出上一轮快照时,它会做差异对比;不带快照时,它先建一份基线,等下一轮再对比。

say.text: 用这份上季竞品快照做基准,列出这轮的实质变化并附证据链接
say.note: 输出带 URL 和日期的变更清单

say.text: 每月自动监控竞品动态,标注哪些 battle card 需要更新
say.note: 无人值守运行,生成报告后停下等人工选择

say.text: 只盯这几家竞品的定价改动,和上次快照对比,没变化就直说
say.note: 低于门槛的信号放进下轮 watchlist

howto.what_en: Diffs against a prior competitive snapshot; reports only material shifts, each with URL+date evidence, and flags stale battle-card/positioning sections. Says so if nothing clears the bar. Without a snapshot, creates a baseline first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to track competitors on a cadence with the prior snapshot provided. With no prior snapshot, it falls back to baseline mode and creates one for the next comparison.

say_en.text: Using last quarter's snapshot as baseline, list material changes with evidence links.
say_en.note: Outputs a changelog with URLs and dates.

say_en.text: Run a monthly competitor watch and flag battle-card sections needing updates.
say_en.note: Runs unattended, files the report, then stops for a human.

say_en.text: Watch pricing only vs the prior snapshot; if no material change, say so.
say_en.note: Below-bar signals are logged for next run.
